summary: ActionRunner.run accepts expected_cost (normalised to minerals/gas/starbux; non-positive and unknown kinds dropped) and records <kind>_uncertain for attempted events whose delta is unobserved (after-snapshot failure, foreign after-snapshot, or a None delta); dry runs, skips and calls without expected cost are unchanged. DailyScheduler passes request.expected_cost. New charged_spend helper in sdk/fleet/audit.py, used by spent_in_period and the budget-exceeded rule, charges observed spend and uncertain spend only where the delta is missing. Progression and PvP reports still read observed deltas only (tested). 11 tests in tests/test_uncertain_spend.py; 9 fail on the old code (the 2 that pass are intended guards). Implemented by a subagent in a worktree; re-validated by the parent.

contract_status_changes.before: Spend from attempts whose effect was not observed was never charged to budgets
contract_status_changes.after: The planned cost of an attempt with an unobserved effect is charged to the account's budget and the audit, separately from observed spend
proof: reviewer repro: spent_in_period now returns {'minerals': 300} after an unobserved 300-mineral upgrade
9 of 11 new tests fail on the previous code; all pass now

residual_risks: Charging planned cost can over-count when an uncertain attempt actually spent nothing; this is deliberately conservative.
docs/baseline/action-runner.md does not yet describe expected_cost; the docs slice updates it.
